pages.title: A Coat for a Friend
pages.text: Introduce pet protection without a deliberate injury requirement.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Brush armadillos for scutes, craft wolf armor and offer it to your tamed wolf. The quest checks armor ownership and the interaction, not damage absorbed.
